intro: Bhutan is a constitutional monarchy, led by the Dragon King and an elected parliament.

chapters.title: How it works
text: King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck has reigned since 2006. The prime minister leads the government, chosen from the elected National Assembly. The constitution lets parliament remove a king.

chapters.title: Protecting nature
text: The constitution says at least 60% of Bhutan must stay forested.
